module: Node "Wheel Distance" (category `repeat_p_duration`). Gives the distance, projected onto the vehicle's direction, between a `position` point (vec3) and the middle of the two closest wheels (by default only the front wheels, `data.onlyUseFrontWheels = true`). Input pins: `vehId`, `position`. Output: `distance` (number, sign: positive when the point is in front of the wheels). `data.debug` enables drawing.
notes: Leaves debug `print`s: `print(tostring(distanceFromStart))` every frame and `print("ERROR1")` if the vehicle or the position is missing.
The `wheels` array is shared: `wheelNodePos` is a single vec3 reused for each wheel, so all entries point to the same value (last wheel) — the average of the two closest wheels is wrong.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

calculateDistanceFromStart.desc: Computes the signed distance between `target` and the closest wheels of the vehicle `vehicle`.

work.desc: Reads the vehicle and the position then writes `distance`.
